The same engine as in v2rayNG: usually faster. Takes effect at the next connection. 64-bit phones only; if you have sites or apps with their own server, per-app rules will not work for them, so the built-in engine stays automatically.
Android does not guarantee the exact time (a shift of a few minutes is possible). If there is no network or the phone is off at that time, collection runs as soon as possible.
Each mode has its own links, blocklist and audit; here you can edit any of them regardless of which mode is on now (✓). Nightly collection runs for each mode that has sources.

Each target has a check address: it shows whether the service opens through the server. For known apps it is filled in automatically, for others only the server's operation is checked; the address can be changed with the "Address" button.

A file with host:, closed:, marker:… lines. If empty or unsuitable, the built-in rules apply: which sites are closed by exit country and by which phrases the "not supported in your country" page is recognized. Updated when the app starts.
